spec.title: Notional Risk by Mimid Account Level ${level}

spec.query:
from(bucket: "Mimid_PnLStatsTestNew")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "acct_lvl_grp_risk")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "grp_risk")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["level"] == "${level}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: $__interval, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "last")

SELECT SUM(last_pnl) FROM (

  AND $timeFilter
  GROUP BY time($__interval), "label", "level" fill(none)
) 
GROUP BY time($__interval)

spec.title: BTC vs ETH (bps from window start)

spec.query:
data = from(bucket: "signals_db/default_signals_retention")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "StrategySignal"
        and r._field == "bid"
        and r.strategy == "BDM_ETHUSDT-PERP_PFG")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

price = data |> set(key: "_field", value: "price")
base  = data |> first() |> set(key: "_field", value: "base")

union(tables: [price, base])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> fill(column: "base", usePrevious: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, asset: "ETH", _value: (r.price / r.base - 1.0) * 10000.0 }))
  |> group(columns: ["asset"])
  |> yield(name: "ETH")

data = from(bucket: "signals_db/default_signals_retention")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "StrategySignal"
        and r._field == "bid"
        and r.strategy == "BDM_BTCUSDT-PERP_PFG")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

price = data |> set(key: "_field", value: "price")
base  = data |> first() |> set(key: "_field", value: "base")

union(tables: [price, base])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> fill(column: "base", usePrevious: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, asset: "BTC", _value: (r.price / r.base - 1.0) * 10000.0 }))
  |> group(columns: ["asset"])
  |> yield(name: "BTC")

spec.title: Daily PnL by Mimid Account Level ${level}

AND $timeFilter 
GROUP BY time($__interval), "label", "level" fill(none)
